fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) had its target price raised by Mizuho from $330 to $335 with Outperform rating maintained, with AWS expected to achieve 40% annual revenue growth over the next two years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Analyst ratings diverge, with Evercore ISI at $355 Outperform and Raymond James downgrading to $250, while the company plans approximately $22 billion in capital expenditures this year.
